english: Heeey!\nMeeting outside the shop - what a surprise!
Eep... oh, hello...
Hmm!\nDid you come to complain\nabout the shop's products!?
Complainers are disliked~ and scary~\nplease contact the support centeeeer,\nheeelp meeee!
N-no, no, that's not it, that's not it~
Oh! Then you came to ask me\nto sell shady stuff\nin my shop!!
I won't allow that!\nPerverts, go home!
Geez, I'm closing up shop!!
Um, this isn't the shop, though...
Huh? It's not?\nGeez, what is it then!! I bet...\nyou're teasing Rin and enjoying it.
How meeean\nYou hate Rin, don't you?
So you're teasing me and\nenjoying my suffering?
U-um... "A toast to your tears!"
Zukyuuun!! Wh-what is this~.\nYou set up this whole flow...\njust to say that line!
Grrrh, that way of thinking!!\nWell played! Bothering Rin,\nthen that line... you're no ordinary guy!
The next line is gonna be\n"You look even lovelier when you smile"\nright~? OH! MY! GOD!!
U-um... please use this handkerchief.
Thank youuu... huh!?\nThis handkerchief... isn't this the bonus item\nfor Magical Warrior Cutie-chan sold at our shop!?
H-hold on, I may need to hear\nthe details... come, COME HERE, pleeease!
Phew, well, whatever - making\na girl cry, what a sinful boy you are!
Hmmmmm...\nOkay! Big sis here will\npeel off one skin!!
(Hm? One skin?? Ohhh, she means lending a hand...)
From now on, when we can meet outside the shop,\ngive me a call!
I'll fix your\ndisorderly bad habits!
Eventually, I'll train you\ninto a fine employee!
...Employee? Huh? What do you mean?
Geez!! Answer me!!
Y-yes ma'am!!
Hi, mom... are you OK...
(She seems busy...\nI'd hate to bother her, so I'll come back later...)
Whoa! Why is there\na square can here!?
Oh! Customer! Another surprise!\nI didn't notice you there at all!
You came properly to be trained~!
Today, I'll teach you greetings!
U-um... I'm... not an employee...
Keep grumbling and\nI'll cut your hourly wage!
Geez, I wish you'd\nfollow Dorothy-chan's example!
(No good... she won't listen...)
Now, greetings are the bare minimum\nof communication between people.
Young people these days can't even greet properly...\nat this rate, never mind economic growth,\ncompanies themselves won't grow...
U-um...
OH! I must apologize...\nthe problem got too big.
Now, greetings!\nLet's try GREETING!!
Easy ones: hello! Sawadee khrap!\nJambo! Konnichiwa! Annyeong!\nAll kinds.
Which country's greeting do you want to master?
You've got a 'whatever' face, don't you?\nThat attitude is BAD!!
You don't understand\nhow important greetings are, do you?
N-no, not at all...\nI think greeting is a wonderful thing that connects people.
OH! NICE opinion!\nExactly! Sometimes a single greeting\nis all it takes for people to understand each other.
U-um, even without greetings,\nif we can communicate when needed, that's fine...?
Oh! I'm disappointed in youu?
Are you an esper?\nSensing people's feelings just by thinking\nis impossible.
But a single greeting can\nCHANGE a person's feelings!
And that can... turn into love?
Kya! So embarrassiing!
Wh-what's with that look!!\nRin is a maiden who'd make flowers blush!
Kids like that get 50 yen docked from their wage!\nHmph!
.........Please go ahead and dock it.
I-I know it's bad, h-here of all places...
Nfuu~... s-someone's coming...\nbut... I can't...
(Wh-what's going on!?\nIs Rin feeling sick?)
Kya!!\nNo, no, noooo!!
Dooon't looook!!
Wh-wh-what's wrong?\nThere's something on your mouth...
N-nothing, NOTHING!\nThere's no way there's a hot dog\nheeeere!!
I-I'm certainly not\npracticing for the hot dog\neating contest or anything...
Hot dog?
U-unbelievable!?\nThat was a leading question!!\nH-how cruel!!
I-I'll join too!!
More rivals means my chances\nof winning go down!
Some young guy from some island nation\nwins every year!! I'm fighting\nfor my country's honor!
Want to go eat something tastier than hot dogs?
OH! Is that the ultimate dish?\nThe one so delicious it makes\nmysterious light shoot from your mouth!
Very very interesting!\n...But is there such a shop around here?
Sorry... what I was going to take you to\nis the legendary Miracle Beef Bowl -\nmiracle beef on rice, a giant stamina bowl...
Fufufu, but that's\na challenge to me, right.
Alright!\nAs a food fighter,\nI can't lose!!
Huh? Food fighter? Aren't you a shop clerk??
I've judged you an official hostile force.
I'll crush you\nbefore the hot dog contest!
First... eating all the shop's\nleftover onigiri!!
Huh? Did you just say 'leftover'?
Next... eating all the leftover bento!
Theeen, leftover oden and nikuman and\nhamburgers and chicken and...
(So there's that much left over...)
Oh? Customer!\nWe meet at the shop, and we meet outside a lot too.
At the shop, we're clerk and customer, so\nwe can't chat too much~.
I-is that so?
Because if we cross the line\nbetween customer and clerk...
we wouldn't be strangers\nanymore, right.
...C-could it be, customer!!\nYou're after that... stare...
Wh-wh-what?\nI don't have any ulterior motives...
Staaare...
Sorry,\nmaybe I did have some ulterior motives...\nno, let's say I did.
OH! I love an honest boy!\nIt's as moving as the story of the boy who honestly\nconfessed to breaking the apple tree and committed seppuku!
(What story is that??)
But you can't win Rin's heart.
Because... Rin and the shop\nare one.
Ufufu, that's a story\nkids wouldn't understand.
But... next time you come to the shop,\nI'll greet you with an angel's smile,\nso hold on.
...But if you come\nfor Dorothy-chan...\nI'll throw piping-hot oden at you.
Happy or sad, I can't tell...
But this town was shut down for a while,\nso the streets are still old, and having\nyoung people like you in town after so long makes me happy.
Aren't you about our age, Rin?
OH! You're kind, customer!\nWe're not allowed to\nleave this town...
To entertain the people\nwho use this town... no,\nnever mind... but...
I don't want people to forget this town.
True, there are no people here,\nand it feels depopulated, right?
YES! Long ago, there was the high economic growth,\nand tons of tough baby-boomers... but\nthey're all gone now.
(...Just how old IS Rin!?)
But right now, are we the only ones in this town?
One moment,\nI'll link to the system and check.
CITY: SOMEWHERE...\nMAIN SERVER LINK\nSEARCH HUMAN HP survival probability...
Wh-what's happening!?
SYSTEM CLEAR:\nMAIN SERVER TO PRIMARY\nSERVER migrating info to SYSTEM... boot!
Let's see!\nI searched everywhere, and besides you folks,\nthere's NOTHING!
...Y-yes...\nth-thank... you...?
Hmmmmm.
(Did something happen? She looks unusually grumpy.\nBetter not go near...)
Wait a sec!\nMove one step and Rin's cash register\nwill breathe fire!
...You look troubled. What's wrong?
It's a thief!
It's no lie!\nThere was a calling card left here!
Let's see... um,\nI think this is just a memo someone dropped...
At this rate, it'll turn into a huge incident,\nlike terrorists taking over a building and\ncrawling around it barefoot!
And Rin's precious shop sign\nwill get scratched!
Before that happens, I'll arrest\nthe thief!
The only clue: this one sheet of paper!\nMaterial: ordinary printer paper!\nWriting: black ballpoint pen!
Nothing points to the culprit!\nBUUUT! I figured it out!
Fufufu, the culprit is among us...
('Among us'... isn't it just me and Rin?)
Yes!! The culprit is you, customer!\nIt's YOU!
(...I figured it'd be that punchline.\nShould I play along here?)
Please stop, even as a joke.
Non! It's no joke!\nThey say the culprit returns to the scene!
H-how did you find out!
Oh! As I thought, the customer\nwas the culprit!
I can't believe the customer was the culprit...\nI thought you were a quiet,\nfriendly, serious young man!
For the care package, leftover\nBlack Thunder choco will do, right?
U-um, this isn't a joke?
...HA HA HA HA~\nSORRY SORRY,\nIT'S JOKE!
Minding the shop was boring, so\nI was just playing around!
When I saw you, customer,\nI wanted to play.\nHAVE FUN?
Don't scare me like that...\nand what a dangerous game...
Oh! When I'm bored,\nI get the urge to play detective!\nFantastic!
(...That doesn't mean drag me into it)
Munya munya... I can't eat anymore...
...She's asleep. I wanted to shop, though...
...No way... the sales\nare... this much...!
With this... mom's hospital bills...\nI won't have to... worry...
Huh? Her way of speaking seems different...
Hmm... huh?\nCustomer... welcome.
Good morning. You talk differently than usual?
Ah...
No, this is... it's different!\nNo wait, it's a MISTAKE!
You don't have to hide it...
...At first, because of an error,\nthat really was how I talked.
But halfway through it got fixed and I could\nspeak normal Japanese...
But Dorothy-chan said\n'it'll draw customers' and\nforced me to...
I see.
Um... customer?\nI have a favor to ask...
Keep it secret, right. I understand.
Sorry. Dorothy-chan would\nget mad at me...
Don't laugh, you mean? I won't laugh.\nEveryone tells me my wishy-washy way of talking\nis weird and creepy, too.
Oh, no, it's not that...
Could you keep\nmy way of talking a secret?
If Dorothy-chan finds out about this,\nshe'll get mad...
And... it's embarrassing...
Understood.
It's a secret between just us two?
Hehe, understood. A secret... it is.
Well then, SEE YOU!\nCustomer! I've got shop duty!
(I thought she was just hyper,\nbut she had an unexpected secret...)
Oh! Customer!\nYou came at just the right time!
Truly 'a summer bug flying into the fire'!
(Feels like more Japanese than before...\nno wait, I have a bad feeling)
I have a favor to ask you, customer!
(As I thought...)
Don't make that face!\nIt's a deal that benefits you too!
And it's very easy\nAND very fun!
...What are you planning to make me do?
Exactly! Let's do a taste test\nof this prototype sample product!
...S-so it's poison tasting...
Non non!\nIt's not leftover food!
We're opening a cafeteria\nin one corner of the shop!
I want you to taste-test\nthe sweets on the menu!
...You think it'll turn out okay?\nMaybe do some market research first...?
Oh! Trying new things\nALWAYS comes with RISK!\nThe FRONTIA SPIRITS are what matter, yo!
Besides, Rin did a proper taste-test too, ne!
If that's how it is...
Good! Then, without further ado... Ta-daa!\nA special parfait, for you-yo!
Let's taste-test, pleeease!
Haah... well then, itadakimasu.\nNom.
It tastes... good, I think.
Really!? Yay!\nEhehe! I worked super hard on it!
(Hm? Her act's slipping...)
Hmm... I can't tell.
Oh! Customer-san really is TASTE-DEAF, ne!
Sorry sorry sorry,\nI couldn't be of any help...
By the way, why is it always me?
It's way more relaxing with a customer, yo!\nBesides...
Even if I accidentally slip into normal speech,\nit's fine 'cause you're a customer...
Huh?
Ah, no. I only said you're special, customer-san.
And with that, the TASTING is FINISHED, ne!\nThank you very much!\nLook forward to the cafeteria opening, ne!
'Just me'... what does that mean?
Huh? This place... a school?\nWhose school is this? It's so lively...
This sign.\nIt says 'Café Bewitching Deep Sea.'
But... I'm drawn to it... I wonder why.
W-welcome!
R-Rin!? What in the world are you wearing...!?
Today... it's a special service, just for you, customer!
Don't tell Dorothy...\nI want you to know the real me...
Doesn't it suit me?
N-no, that's not it!\nIt suits you really well...
...Or do you prefer\nthe usual me...?
Not the me you've known till now...\nToday, I want you to know my true feelings...
Y-your true feelings!?
You don't get it?\nYou're mean.
A girl waits to be told, you know.
OH! You say 'boku,' ne?
Ha! Rin!? Huh? You're in your usual uniform...
Of course!\nToday too I'm VERY genki and business is booming, yo!\nObviously, sho?
Huh? But your true feelings...?
What's happen!?\nWhat are you saying, ne?
Hn!? Huh!? Something's off!?!?
It was... a dream...
Oh! Customer-san looks down, ne!\nWhen that happens, SHOPPING is good, yo!\nBuy veeery lots, ne!
Still super busy, yo!\nTIME IS MONEY, yo!
But my true feelings... some other time, okay!
